panels.description: Adrian's blue recording projection appears above the workbench. Keep the upper projection field clear.
Adrian looks directly toward Alex through the projection. Keep the upper projection clear.
Alex grips the old watch while Adrian's projection flickers. Keep the upper frame empty.
The projection destabilizes above the workshop equipment. Keep the upper machinery clear.

items.speaker: ADRIAN
items.text: Alex. If you’re seeing this, I failed to come back.

items.speaker: ADRIAN
items.text: I borrowed too much. I gambled some of it. I hurt you and Grandmother.

items.speaker: ADRIAN
items.text: The work was shared. The mistakes were mine.
